base_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT THE ATTACHED GRAND ARCADE BUILDING PHOTO into one client-facing premium facade renovation concept, full facade landscape architectural photograph.
ABSOLUTE GEOMETRY LOCK: EXACTLY FOUR ENTRANCE OPENINGS arranged from left to right SMALL — GRAND — SMALL — SMALL. ONE smaller arched doorway on the LEFT of the main central grand arch; TWO smaller arched doorways on the RIGHT. Never add a fifth doorway, never symmetrize the building, never move or resize these four openings. Retain camera viewpoint, facade width, stepped roof volumes, upper-right small room and forecourt. Every opening must be a functioning glass entrance door at ground level with visible door leaves and handles; fixed arched fanlight above. Keep thresholds unobstructed. Main entrance much larger than three side entrances.
USER'S CENTRAL DESIGN REQUEST: completely replace existing sandy beige side walls with richly detailed architectural cladding in the specified palette. Redesign the main arch SURROUND without changing its opening size. Detail the upper-right rooftop room with deliberate grooves, fluting, slim projecting fins or panel reveals, coordinated with the new facade. No blank large black or white panels. Show buildable modular ACP cassette seams, textured exterior panels, metal trims, carefully aligned reveals, and concealed restrained warm light. Rich detail but curated, not ornamental clutter. The building should remain predominantly dark in each option, with contrasting material highlights.
Branding: exact readable "GRAND ARCADE" above grand door in tasteful dimensional metal lettering. Remove the subtitle; no added slogans or claims. Small lower-left "ILLUSTRATIVE FACADE CONCEPT" caption. No people, no cars, no unrelated architecture. Keep minimal landscaping clear of doors. Premium realistic material finishes, high-detail presentation with enough ambient daylight to read dark textures, no black-crushed night image, no oversaturated gold glow. One image, no collage.
SPECIFIC DISTINCT DESIGN:

concepts.title: Dark charcoal walls with sculpted ivory arch
concepts.direction: The entire side wings are charcoal-black deeply brushed stone-look composite panels with tight HORIZONTAL GROOVES, not beige. Main grand arch is framed by a striking off-white / ivory double-layer sculpted surround: radial segmented narrow ivory ribs around the semicircle continuing as vertical flutes down both jambs, with a fine bronze shadow reveal between two arch layers. Central signage field is anthracite microfluted paneling, not flat white. Side door surrounds are narrow brushed bronze. Upper-right rooftop room is DARK CHARCOAL VERTICAL FINS at a regular spacing with three discreet bronze vertical inlays and a recessed horizontal light slot, no blank panels. Crisp dark/ivory contrast, late-afternoon daylight, restrained 3000K arch inner-edge light.

concepts.title: Walnut, beige and charcoal
concepts.direction: Side wall cladding entirely rich medium-dark WALNUT wood-look panels with a clear vertical grain and alternating narrow recessed slat bands on solid piers. Broad central arch surround made of THREE concentric stepped rings: outer dark charcoal finely ribbed metal, middle narrow warm beige textured composite, inner brushed bronze. Central sign panel dark walnut horizontal planks with delicate champagne divider strips. Beige only as a controlled arch accent, never broad sandy walls. Upper-right room wrapped in walnut vertical louvers over black backing, with a crisply framed dark charcoal horizontal band and slim linear shadow gaps. Matching charcoal canopy edges and walnut soffits. Dark warm premium showroom, natural late afternoon.

concepts.title: Maroon, black and bronze
concepts.direction: Distinctive wine-MAROON ribbed exterior metal/composite panels on side wings with fine vertical bronze reveals at grouped intervals; very deep aubergine-black central signage tower. Main arch surround in rich dark bronze with a WIDE FACETED stepped chamfer following the arch, engraved narrow radial grooves, two slim inset champagne rings and soft concealed light within the inner reveal. Side arches framed in satin black with bronze edging. Upper-right room alternates wide dark wine panels with closely spaced BLACK VERTICAL FINS and a thin bronze horizontal belt. Deep burgundy is clearly visible under soft overcast late-day daylight, not brown and not bright red. Matte finishes, warm subtle lighting, no beige or sand wall surfaces.

concepts.title: Espresso, copper and graphite
concepts.direction: Side wings fully clad in dark ESPRESSO wood-look horizontal panels with pronounced natural grain, staggered neat joints and slender black recessed lines. Main arch has a layered contemporary surround with broad ribbed GRAPHITE outer band, narrow brushed COPPER middle arch and softly textured dark chocolate inner reveal; radial fluting around curve, vertical flutes down jambs. Signage field features an orderly dark graphite diagonal herringbone relief panel pattern, with readable champagne GRAND ARCADE. Upper-right room features horizontal dark brown louvers interrupted by three slim copper vertical fins, graphite frame and recessed warm soffit spots. Architectural dark brown/copper palette; early blue hour with ample ambient fill to clearly read textures, no sandy walls.
